title: [Preview Pane] Enable nullable reference types

status.label: Awaiting maintainer review
status.detail: Four current-head nullable contract suggestions are grounded, form one complete atomic group, pass raw-blob LF/BOM checks, and were validated by building all 26 exact-upstream changed projects plus all four literal suggestion provider projects (x64 Debug). Candidate unit-test and manual runtime/UI/ARM64 checks are optional follow-up for these signature-only annotations; the attempted candidate test hit a CsWinRT generator crash, while three test projects were not attempted.

next_action: Review the four nullable-parameter suggestions and, if approved, select the complete atomic group together for a non-blocking COMMENT review.

proposed_comments.title: (1/4) Declare nullable image input
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/4) Declare nullable image input

**Severity:** `medium`

The implementation returns `null` when `image` is `null`, but this public signature declares a non-null `Image` parameter in a nullable-enabled project. A caller with an `Image?` value receives CS8604, and a `null` literal receives CS8625, despite the explicit null guard. Annotate the parameter to match the supported input contract, and select all four provider changes together.

```suggestion
        public static Bitmap? ResizeImage(Image? image, int width, int height)
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream implementation explicitly returns null for a null image, while the newly nullable-enabled public signature rejects that input at compile time.

selection_group.title: Align nullable resize input contracts across Preview Pane
